endorsements.name: Simon Roses Femerling
endorsements.label: Dude, Where’s My Laptop?
endorsements.description: On a daily basis we carry laptops, tables, smartphones and all kind of gadgets containing personal and corporate information, and thousands of those devices get lost or stolen. According to the FBI, losses due to laptop theft rise more than $3.5 million in 2005 and in 2011 the NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics and Research reported that thefts of laptops have been on the increase over the last 10 years costing millions in losses every year.
